title: Recall: Return values from blocks and functions
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

function.clue: Write the complete function minutes_to_seconds taking minutes: u32 and returning u32. Use the tail expression minutes * 60, with no return keyword or trailing semicolon in the body.

guard.clue: Inside fn capped(value: u32, limit: u32) -> u32, write an if statement that returns limit early only when value exceeds limit. Use the > operator and an explicit return.
